This Stanley Sort Master organiser set provides robust and flexible tool storage solutions for trade professionals and DIY enthusiasts. Featuring durable plastic construction, the set includes one large and two small organisers with customisable, removable dividers, allowing up to 1024 compartment configurations to suit various small parts and fixings. The 90° compartments are ideal for securing hand tools and preventing movement during transit, and the hinged lid with lockable plastic clamps ensures contents remain securely in place. The convenient carrying handle offers easy portability around workshops and job sites.
